entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahmad ibn 'Abdallah al-Marwazi, known as Habash al-Hasib was a Persian astronomer, geographer, and mathematician from Merv in Khorasan, who discovered the trigonometric ratios tangent, and cotangent. Al-Biruni who cited Habash in his work, expanded his astronomical tables.
